item.title: 【Requests】[REQ CAP] - Festival de Verão Salvador 2026
item.description:
Hello, the festival will be broadcast on Multishow and Globoplay, please could someone capture the shows from saturday? Thanks in advance/ Desde já, obrigado.
The broadcast will start at 18h30:
  • Caetano Veloso
  • Carlinhos Brown
  • Dominguinho (João Gomes, Mestrinho e Jota.Pê)
  • Ivete Sangalo
  • Ney Matogrosso
  • Rachel Reis convida Márcio Victor
